invariants.statement: The candidate serves only same-origin HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, and images; every remote runtime request and effect is forbidden.
acceptance_obligations: Browser evidence records zero non-same-origin requests.
Every required WACZ presentation asset has distinct source and runtime copies.

invariants.statement: Exactly two of three promotional items are visible and their selected position changes only after explicit previous, next, indicator, or keyboard input; no autoplay occurs.
acceptance_obligations: State and browser tests exercise forward, reverse, direct, keyboard, and observation-without-input behavior.

invariants.statement: Uncaptured destinations never masquerade as reconstructed pages; they remain on the homepage with a visible archive-boundary notice or return an explicit 404.
acceptance_obligations: Search, login, join, and content controls create no navigation or remote effect.
